text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr has surpassed the Mile Emperor and proven that a free wind cannot be contained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her crucial first three years come to a close in the best possible way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while still basking in the glory of our accomplishments…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah… That's a pleasant breeze. What do you think of it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Yamanin Zephyr and I have come out for a stroll in a forest near her hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer, what an opportune airstream we have here. Take a look over there—it's a Big-Beak.
choice_data_list: Wow, you're right. It's a cute little greenfinch!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: They set off on a journey at the start of spring, so we're lucky to have seen one. What a propitious flurry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Oriental greenfinch is a wild bird known for having a large beak. Although they're not particularly rare, people tend not to notice them unless they're paying attention.
choice_data_list: That's the true joy of these leisurely strolls, isn't—huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look around to see that Yamanin Zephyr has vanished without my noticing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Phew.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… Where did you get off to? Did you find yourself a pappus on the wind for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she was the one that disappeared, I decide not to push back on her query.
choice_data_list: Yeah. I took a little detour.
Yeah. I took a little detour.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You must have felt a roseate current. Was there rustling?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I'm glad. Say, shall we let the benison breeze blow?
choice_data_list: You want to relax? Okay, let's head down to the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh? Erm, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Something feels a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well… I think I'm a little out of step with other people.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Often, the conversations I'm in come to a standstill, and I'm asked to repeat myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And sometimes I'll be walking alongside someone, only to suddenly end up on my own…
choice_data_list: (None of this really comes as a surprise…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I always assumed these experiences were normal, and never gave them a second thought…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But when I'm with you, even when that kind of thing happens… it doesn't really bother me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …It's strange.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, we have spent three years in each other's company, after all. It's no wonder I've gotten used to her, or at least gotten an idea of what to expect from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To put it in her words…
choice_data_list: I think I've become a weather vane.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …A weather vane?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, perhaps it's…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Interesting… You've become a true wind as well—for me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Deep down, I think a part of me always felt that "becoming the wind" was a ridiculous dream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But even so, once I started getting good results in my races, people started telling me that I ran like the wind.
choice_data_list: That's all your hard work paying off.
That's all your hard work paying off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You may be right. But still… I believe there's been a wind at my back all along, pushing me forwards.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You were that fair wind at my back, Trainer. And thanks to you, I've soared to heights I never thought I'd reach.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I was just a leaf drifting about on the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if I am pushing her forward, she was the one who ultimately achieved those results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why, dare I say it…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The winds are free spirits, and that's exactly why they're able to overlap and blow as one.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Heh heh… Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A warm updraft, a sweet breeze, a refreshing whoosh… It feels as though countless currents suddenly just picked up into one comforting wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Will you stay a bit longer?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's bathe in the wind, right here… Just for a little longer.
